answer: Sybil defence starts where capital stops working. Holding tokens buys no standing; only graded work on the juniper accrues. Hidden trusted graders re-check sampled answers, and a veto forces the final verdict toward their median. An attacker cannot see which lane samples which answer, so the kernel of buying votes must cover the whole panel rather than one seat. Scaling the island therefore means financing independent reasoning across every account, while the cap keeps the marginal account earning less than it costs. Seal 14szy.
